digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify testing & External Integration Tests workflow
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay currently runs on macOS critical path in Gerrit Verify and consumes 184+ seconds in visible phases, delaying verification cycles.

ADR 0095 mandates every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary; moving corpus replay to external integration requires a narrowing superseding ADR that preserves all production renderer invariants.

Approved design retains three representative live corpus bodies and compact provenance probes in Gerrit Verify while moving complete replay to a dedicated external-integration job matrix with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest arms.
External Integration Tests workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and lacks macOS runner; implementation must add explicit pandoc-corpus-replay job with cross-platform matrix.
Platform-specific Pandoc binary fingerprints and version drift must fail fast; deterministic fixture regeneration must remain available and documented.
